detail: Diyanet opening record gives 34 m, 72 m, four 107.1 m three-balcony minarets and two 90 m two-balcony minarets, the courtyard and lower ancillary space.
Official opening report quotes completed building association dimensions and distinguishes inner and outer courts.
Üsküdar’s municipal account records selection of Hayriye Gül Totu and Bahar Mızrak’s traditional mosque and courtyard design.
Construction association chairman Ergin Külünk’s on-site statement describes lead covering, 7.77 m finial, and 26 courtyard domes.
